# CANDIDATE: VOL_COMP_VWAP_RIBBON_FLIP_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of low ATR (volatility compression), a close above VWAP coupled with a bullish EMA ribbon flip signals an imminent expansion move. The edge exists because volatility contraction often precedes expansion, and the VWAP close with EMA ribbon alignment provides directional confirmation that avoids false breakouts in choppy conditions.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: ATR(20) is less than 0.5 times its 20‑day average for at least three consecutive 5‑minute bars (compression phase); on the bar following compression, price closes above VWAP and the EMA ribbon (9,20,50) flips from bearish (price below all EMAs) to bullish (price above all EMAs); volume > 1.2x the average volume of the last 20 bars. Exit shape: Chart‑stop at the lowest point of the compression zone (structure invalidation), TP1 at 2R, runner trailed using a Chandelier exit (ATR*3) after TP1. Regime hint: Effective when VIX > 22 (elevated volatility regime) and during the window 10:00‑14:30, avoiding the first and last 30 minutes of the session.
